prompts: Show me sales for this month

responses.cash: Your current cash position looks stable based on the latest ledger and bank data. Review bank reconciliation for any outstanding items.
responses.invoice: I can help draft an invoice or review invoice aging. Try asking for open invoice totals or a draft invoice summary.
responses.sales: Monthly sales are trending in line with expectations. I can break this down by customer, product, or region if you want.
responses.balance: I can summarize balances by account, subsidiary, or consolidated group. Ask for a trial balance or cash balance view.
